description: Create Digital Twin React UI component with React Flow zone visualization, device overlays, telemetry drawer, anomaly banner, SSE subscription hook, and device simulator. Add comprehensive integration tests covering end-to-end flow (register device → POST telemetry → ledger → SSE → UI) and error scenarios. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (can be developed in parallel once their APIs are known).
steps: Create components/DigitalTwin.tsx with DigitalTwinProps { initialZone?: LedgerZone, webhookEndpoint?: string (default: http://localhost:8787/webhooks/telemetry), sseEndpoint?: string (default: http://localhost:8787/sse) }. Use @xyflow/react (already in root package.json). Component renders: (1) ReactFlow canvas with 5 zone nodes (FIZ, FCZ, CONTROL, CROSS, IOT) arranged in a graph layout, (2) Device overlays: fetch devices from MCP resource tradeops://iot/devices or GET /api/devices proxy, render device icons (📱 RFID, 📷 camera, 📍 GPS, 🌡️ sensor, 🏷️ barcode) at zone node positions, (3) Telemetry drawer: right side panel (collapsible, default open), displays last 10 telemetry events from SSE stream, scrollable list with timestamp, deviceId, sensorValue, unit, anomaly badge, (4) Anomaly banner: top fixed banner (dismissible, red background), shows latest anomaly event with deviceId, zoneId, value, timestamp, close button, (5) Device simulator button: bottom right FAB, opens modal with form (deviceId select, payload textarea, signature input auto-computed), on submit POSTs to webhookEndpoint.

Create useZoneSSE custom hook in components/DigitalTwin.tsx: function useZoneSSE(zoneId: string, endpoint: string): SSEEvent[]. Uses EventSource to connect to {endpoint}/{zoneId}, listens for SSE messages, parses JSON SSEEvent { type, deviceId, zoneId, telemetry, timestamp, anomaly }, maintains array of last 50 events in state, returns events array. Handles connection errors, reconnects on disconnect, cleans up on unmount.

Create components/DigitalTwin.module.css (optional) with styles for: .digitalTwin (container, flex layout), .canvas (React Flow container), .drawer (right side panel, width 300px, overflow-y scroll), .anomalyBanner (top fixed, z-index 1000, red bg), .simulatorButton (bottom right FAB, z-index 999), .telemetryEvent (list item, border-b, padding). Use Tailwind classes if project uses Tailwind, otherwise vanilla CSS.

Create tests/integration.spec.ts with end-to-end integration tests: (1) 'register device → POST telemetry → ledger event → SSE broadcast': start server, call registerIoTDevice MCP tool, POST to /webhooks/telemetry with valid HMAC, query ledger for iot.telemetry.received event, assert event exists with correct deviceId/payload, connect SSE client to /sse/IOT, assert SSE message received matching telemetry. (2) 'error: device not found': POST telemetry for non-existent deviceId, assert 404 response. (3) 'error: bad signature': POST telemetry with invalid HMAC, assert 401 response. (4) 'error: expired timestamp': POST telemetry with timestamp >60s old, assert 400 response. (5) 'error: rate limit exceeded': POST 1001 telemetry requests for same deviceId within 1 minute, assert 1001st request returns 429. (6) 'anomaly detection': POST telemetry with out-of-range value, query ledger, assert payload.anomaly=true, query anomalyReport MCP tool, assert event in results.

Verify existing Part A tests still pass: npm test -- tools.spec.ts, npm test -- auth.spec.ts, npm test -- ledger.spec.ts. Assert no regressions (45 tests pass unchanged). Update .env.example with WEBHOOK_SECRET=your-secret-here, IOT_WEBHOOK_PORT=8788, IOT_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT=1000. Update README.md IoT section: describe 7 new tools, 4 new resources, webhook/SSE endpoints, Digital Twin UI route /digital-twin, environment variables, example curl commands for webhook POST and SSE GET.
acceptance_criteria: components/DigitalTwin.tsx renders React Flow canvas with 5 zone nodes (FIZ, FCZ, CONTROL, CROSS, IOT)
Device overlays fetch devices from backend and render icons at zone node positions
Telemetry drawer displays last 10 telemetry events from SSE stream, scrollable, shows timestamp/deviceId/value/unit/anomaly
Anomaly banner appears at top when anomaly event received, dismissible, red background, shows deviceId/zone/value/timestamp
Device simulator button opens modal with form to POST mock telemetry to webhook endpoint
useZoneSSE hook connects to SSE endpoint, receives SSEEvent messages, maintains events array, handles reconnection
tests/integration.spec.ts end-to-end test: register device → POST telemetry → ledger event exists → SSE broadcast received
tests/integration.spec.ts error tests: device not found (404), bad signature (401), expired timestamp (400), rate limit (429), anomaly detection (payload.anomaly=true)
npm test (all Part A tests + FEAT-001 tests + FEAT-002 tests + integration tests pass, no regressions)
README.md IoT section documents 7 tools, 4 resources, webhook/SSE endpoints, Digital Twin UI, environment variables, example commands
verification: npm run typecheck (no TypeScript errors in components/DigitalTwin.tsx)
npm test -- integration.spec.ts (all integration and error tests pass)
npm test (all tests pass: Part A 45 + FEAT-001 IoT unit tests + FEAT-002 MCP tests + FEAT-003 integration tests)
npm run build (MCP server compiles successfully)
npm run dev (Next.js dev server starts)
Manual: open http://localhost:3000/digital-twin → React Flow zone graph renders with 5 nodes
Manual: register device via simulator → device icon appears on zone node
Manual: POST telemetry via simulator → telemetry drawer updates with new event, SSE stream receives event
Manual: POST out-of-range telemetry → anomaly banner appears at top, dismissible
